name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Operations Analyst | Data Accuracy, File Auditing & Process Improvement
summary: Operations professional with 15+ years in SaaS and service businesses, focused on getting data right and keeping processes clean. I run batch data imports, map records to CRM fields, enforce data-hygiene standards, and build rubrics to audit output against a standard. Experienced in Excel, SQL, and Power BI, with employer-side HR experience handling I-9s and W-4s, approving team hours and PTO, and basic bookkeeping.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Run batch/CSV data imports into GoHighLevel and other platforms, mapping records to the target system's fields and enforcing strict data-hygiene standards.
Built rubric-based grading criteria to audit automated and AI-generated output against defined standards, and personally review and label the data.
Build Excel and Power BI reporting, using SQL on BigQuery data, to spot discrepancies and track performance.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded 15-20 partners, making sure every end customer's local-listings data was configured correctly, and retained all but one (~94%).

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Rebuilt internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors.

bullets: Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.
Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), approving hours, PTO, and schedules, and training new hires.
